content: Ãi hoidde hiyan oilde endilla: Mirazdar zetodin nabalok take hite hár kissur giros oile o, hite loi ekzon gulam loi hono forok no take.
Bafe osiyot namat ṭaim ṭik gori giyede he foijjonto hitattu he murubbi edde biššaši sõloya okkolor tole taka fore.
Hendila ãra o nabalok takite, duniyabi ruhur šikkar tole gulam aššilam.
Kintu ṭaim zehon furafuri bafe aišše, Allaye hibar Futore defeṛaiye, ze ek mayafuwattu zormo oiye, edde Torar ain mozin soille,
ainor tole aššilde hitarare azad goribolla, toi zene ãra Allar fuwain oi fari.
Tũwara fuwainde hetolla, Allaye hibar Futor Ruhure ãrar dilot defeṛaiye, ze Ruhuye "Abba, Baf" hoi ḍake.
Hetolla tũwara ar gulam nai, bolke Allar fuwain. Tũwara hibar fuwain oiyode hisabe, Allaye tũwarare o Mosir fũwati mirazdar goijje.
Galatiyo biššaši okkololla Paulosor sinta
Age zẽtte tũwara Allare no sinita, hẽtte zara asole allah no tũwara hitarar gulamir tole aššila.

Ar ehon, tũwara Allare sinno bolke endilla howa za ze Allaye tũwarare goisse, henot tũwara kengori abar duniyaibi komzur edde behazor ruhur mikka firi zorgoi? Tũwarattu hono abar hitarar gulam oito mone hor ne?
Tũwara hás hás din, maš, musum, edde bosor okkol falon goror!
Ãi tũwaralla ḍorair, ze haṛoni ãi tũwaralla goijji hin hono behazor goillam ne.
Báiboinain okkol, ãi tũwarar hãse foriyad gorir, tũwara ãr ḍoilla o, kiyollahoile ãi o tũwarar ḍoilla oiyi. Tũwara ãr hono hoti no goro.
Iyan to tũwara zanode hota, ze ãr biyaramor zoriya foilabar ãi tũwarar hãse kušir hóbor tobolig gori faijjilam.
Ãr biyaramor zoriya zodi o ãi tũwaralla ugguwa fũza oilam, to ãre tũwara ošormani otóba batil no goro, bolke tũwara ãre Allar ek firistare ba Mosi Isare gosefan gori gossila.
Ehon tũwarar dilottu he kuši hoṛe giyegoi? Ãi tũwarar babute endilla goba di faijjum ze, faitta boli tũwarar nizor suk udda kuli ãre difelaita.
Tũwarare soyi hoiyore hono ãi ehon tũwarar dušmon oigilamboi ne?

Misa šikka doya okkol zarar babute ãi tũwarare hoilam hitara tũwarar dil zitito sadde, hiyan balailla no. Hitara sadde oilde šude tũwarare ãttu alok goitto, toi zene tũwara hitarar fisa loibolla issa goro.
Issa takon bala, hiyan zodi balalla o, ar hiyan hamišalla owa foribo, šude ãi tũwarar fũwati takide hẽtte oile no oibo.
O ãr adoijja fuwain okkol, zetodin tũwarar butore Mosi no bone, hetodin foijjonto ugguwa fuwa oibar šomot zendilla maye duk fa, hendilla ãi tũwarare loi duk fair.
Ãttu hondilla mone hor hoile zodi ãi ehon tũwarar hãse ai faittam hotagunore ãi tũwara loi oinno ḍoilla gori hoitam. Ãi tũwaralla beši sintat forigiyigoi.
Hazera edde Sarar mesal
Tũwara zarattu Torar ainor tole taito mone hor, ãi tũwarattu fusar gori, aine ki ho tũwara no funo?
Kiyollahoile endilla leka ase ze, Ibrahimottu dui fut aššil, ekzon bandi maya fuwattu oiye, ar ekzon nizor bou Sarattu oiye.
Ziba bandi maya fuwattu zormo oiye hiba duniyair niyom mozin oiye, ar ziba nizor bouwottu zormo oiye hiba Allar wada mozin oiye.
Ei hotagan mesal hisabe lowa or: Ei mayafuwain dunizon duiyan suktir ḍoilla. Sukti ziyan Sinai faharottu aišše, hiyane manušore ainor tole gulam banai raikke. Hazera hiyanor ḍoilla.
Hiba oilde Arob dešor Sinai fahar, ar hiba ei duniyair Zeruzalem šohor loi ek ḍoilla, kiyollahoile hiyanor manuš okkol ainor gulamir tole ase.
Kintu Sarah oilde behostor Zeruzalem loi ek ḍoilla ziyan azad, hiba ãrar ma.
Kiyollahoile pak kitabot leka ase ze,

content.text: tottu zattu honodin fuwain no o,
edde fuwa biyar duk búg gora no fore,
tui anondo gor, kušiye dõr gori uzor de,

content: Báiboinain okkol, Isakor ḍoilla tũwara o wadar fuwain.
He ṭaimot Ibrahimor fut Ismail, ziba duniyair niyom mozin zormo oiye, hite Allar Ruhur bole oiyede he Isakore zulum goitto. Ehon o hendila or.
Kintu pak kitabe ki ho? Pak kitabe hor ze, "Ei bandi mayafuware edde ibar futore niyolai do, kiyollahoile ei bandir fute azad mayafuwar futor fũwati šombottir mirazdar no oibo."
Hetolla báiboinain okkol, ãra bandi mayafuwar fuwain no, bolke azad mayafuwar fuwain okkol.
